Name: Island Cellar Update
Author: iamsaulc
Description:
[size=3]With this mod you will have the possibility of having a cellar in the island house, it has different sizes and allows you to customize the floor of it.
[/size]
[size=3][b]Configuration:[/b]
[list]
[*]Cellar size: [i]Choose the size of the cellar, allowed values: default, big, excessive, standard[/i]
[*]Fixing [i]the cellar floor: Fixing the cellar floor, allowable values: yes, no[/i]
[/list][/size]
[size=3][i]This mod is an update of the mod "[/i][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8488]Island Cellar[/url][/b][i]" to version 1.6, I contacted the creator and he gave me permission to do so and also told me that he would no longer update his mods.[/i][/size]

Downloads.Description: Fixed the bug that did not allow to change the size of the cellar with the game already started.

Manifest.Name: Island Cellar Update
Manifest.Description: Add a cellar to your cabin on the island
